prerequisites: Ability to analyze, synthesize, and interpret.
Ability to report orally and in writing.

learning_outcomes.text: To factually clarify and illustrate concepts from theoretical courses.
To sharpen communication skills (oral and written reporting, use of word processor, communication in languages other than the mother tongue, ...).
To acquire 'sense of reality': to learn to assess the usefulness and limitations of theoretical concepts and experimental techniques through critical observation.
To gain experience with project work and work planning.
To develop analytical thinking and a sense of synthesis.
To read and process scientific literature.
To develop a research and development attitude.

syllabus_topics: The bachelor's thesis is a project work around a materials science research theme.
assessment_rules: Evaluation is continuous without an exam during the examination period. Oral and written reporting are required. The technical-scientific quality of the final result is always decisive in determining the final score. More information will be provided via Toledo if necessary.
institution: KU Leuven - Faculty of Engineering Science
degree: Bachelor in de ingenieurswetenschappen (Bachelor of Engineering Science, Leuven)
